in_marathi.name: Muthusamy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muthusamy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muthusamy is derived from the Tamil language. This name is composed of two words: ‘Muthu’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Samy’ meaning ‘Wealth’. In Hindu mythology, Muthusamy is often associated with the god of wealth, Kubera.
